$comment: The open-call record contract. Enforced by scripts/build-registry.mjs, which is the only validator — there is no JSON Schema runtime in this repository and no dependency is added for one.
$rule: A blank field is a finding; a fabricated one is a defect. Nothing in a record may be filled in from memory or inferred from a programme's usual cycle. If it was not read off a named source, it is null and it is marked.

notes.date_basis: confirmed — a human read the date off the organisation's own page. sourced — the date was read off a named third party recorded in sourced_from, and primary confirmation is still owed. none — there is no date on this record, either because the programme is between cycles or because nobody has looked yet. The two are told apart by `verified`.
notes.closes: Non-null only when date_basis is confirmed or sourced. Never a guess, never carried over from last year's cycle.
notes.opens: Same rule as closes. Blank across the seed set because no open date was sourced.
notes.cycle_note: Required whenever closes is null: says why there is no date, and carries the ⟦FILL⟧ marker naming what is still owed. Also used on dated records to carry the cycle's terms (time zone, constituency, field-specific variants).
notes.sourced_from: The URL actually read to obtain closes, or the one that established there is no open call. Null only when nobody has looked.
notes.verified: ISO date a human last checked this record against a source, or null if never. A null verified forces register to V. A non-null verified requires sourced_from.
notes.register: O observed in this repository, D documented against a named source, I inferred, V unverified. Same register marks the README uses. I is not a legal value for a date — inference is what this contract exists to prevent.
notes.award: min/max null when no figure was sourced. `basis` follows the same three values as date_basis; when it is not `none`, a figure must be present.
notes.stage: The workflow stage this record currently sits in. Must be a stage id declared in data/workflow.json. The engine owns every transition out of it.
notes.drafts: Materials attached to this opportunity: [{ label, href, state }]. Empty is the honest default — a draft is attached when one exists. No applicant-identifying content belongs in a record; a draft is a label and a link, never a person.
